newsitem.title: USA: Phonetel extends cash tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Phonetel extends cash tender offer.

text.p: PhoneTel Technologies Inc said on Tuesday that it would extend its previously announced cash tender offer for all outstanding common shares of Communications Central Inc.
The tender offer and withdrawal rights will now expire at midnight, New York City time, on August 18, 1997, PhoneTel said in a statement.
In May, PhoneTel said it extended the offer to August 5.

As of noon Tuesday, PhoneTel said, 6,038,912 shares had been tendered to First Union National Bank of North Carolina, the depositary for the tender offer, representing about 84 percent of the common shares outstanding on a fully diluted basis.
